import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. # It contains two placeholders: {title} and {body}. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Format a user‑submitted blog entry for safe display in HTML. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title or headline of the blog post. text : str The full body content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized, HTML‑escaped blog post ready to be injected into a page. Notes ----- - Uses html.escape to neutralize any HTML special characters in user input, preventing cross‑site scripting (CWE‑79). - The function does **not** perform any further sanitization (e.g., stripping scripts or CSS) beyond escaping; callers should ensure that only trusted content is passed if more stringent filtering is required. """ # Escape user input to avoid injection of malicious HTML/JS safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Insert escaped content into the template return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
